slides.title: Tigray's war is moving on several fronts
slides.body: What was reported Oct 20-23, according to the Critical Threats Project

slides.title: Tigrayan forces reportedly back in Rama
slides.body: On Oct 22, about 25 miles north of Adwa near the Eritrean border, after federal troops redeployed to central Tigray (citing ACLED). Not independently verified.

slides.title: Clashes near the Amhara border
slides.body: On Oct 22, fighting on the road west of Woldia halted traffic between Istayish and Sanka, CTP reported, citing DW. Reports differ on whether traffic has resumed.

slides.title: An unverified claim in the west
slides.body: Benishangul Gumuz state TV claimed TPLF vehicles crossed in from Sudan on Oct 22. CTP said it could not verify the claim.

slides.title: tonnes of medical supplies
slides.body: delivered by WHO to conflict-hit Tigray, Amhara and Afar, Capital Ethiopia reported on Oct 21.

slides.title: Protect civilians on every front.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Critical Threats Project, Oct 23; Capital Ethiopia, Oct 21, 2026
